source_segments.text: , duc de Chartres , ( later duc d'Orléans ) , the Regent of France under Louis XV .
Louis-Alexandre de Bourbon , comte de Toulouse 6 June 1678 1 December 1737 Legitimised on 22 November 1681 .
Held numerous offices , of which : Admiral of France , Governor of Guyenne , Governor of Brittany , and Grand-Veneur de France .
Was also duc de Damville , de Rambouillet et de Penthièvre .
Founder of the House of Bourbon-Toulouse .
Paternal legitimate half-siblings - by Marie-Thérèse d'Autriche , Infanta of Spain , Queen
